description.text: Scholarship Policy: According to the strategy cooperation agreement between SICAS and University of Jinan, the students who get admission in this major through SICAS only have to pay CNY16,800/Year instead of CNY 26,800 /Year from the second year and the third year. The first year is not included. The scholarship will directly to reduce the tuition, not cash. Special Scholarship for SICAS International Students in University of Jinan (click to apply)

duration.text: The Foreign Linguistics and Applied Linguistics at University of Jinan is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3722 USD/per year ￥ 26800 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Original level 6 or new level 4 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.Undergraduate school transcript 5.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 6.Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 7.Resume Should be written in Chinese or in English

requirements.text: 1.The acceptable applicants include students sent by the foreign educational institutions and legal non-governmental organizations and self-paid individuals from foreign countries. 2.Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 3.Applicants must Be in good health
